concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity, attractive, practical desktop fantasy RPG destination-selection screen, widescreen 16:9, designed to work at 1280x720. Image 1 is CONTEXT REFERENCE ONLY: current game's three destinations, Chinese language, colorful chunky cartoon fantasy world. Completely redesign its unattractive generic layout. Output a straight-on polished game UI screenshot, not a physical device, not a presentation board, no external annotations. Keep only three destination choices: 苍风原野 (available/selected), 迷雾林地 (locked), 赤岩裂谷 (locked). Locked places remain visually identifiable and enticing, clear padlock plus readable unlock condition; never almost-invisible gray cards or diagonal hatching. Preserve game progression, no invented currencies, travel costs, levels, stats, reward systems or extra destinations. Chinese text must be crisp and correctly spelled, sparse and readable. One unmistakable primary button labelled 出发远行, usable close X in upper right. Premium hand-painted fantasy scenery, substantial silhouettes, rich greens and warm gold, well-organized typography, disciplined ornament that never crowds the content. Distant camp-game scenery softly blurred behind the interface. No watermarks, no English slogans. The entire UI fits the screenshot with generous margins.
Direction A: illustrated exploration atlas. Large landscape atlas occupies left 72% of a navy-and-bronze framed panel; right 28% is a clean selected-region information column, separated by a quiet divider, with no nested cards. Hand-painted bird's-eye map with a sunny meadow lower left, mysterious teal fog forest upper middle, red rocky volcanic canyon upper right, and one subtle winding dashed travel path connecting them. Selected meadow landmark has a clear amber pin and a restrained golden boundary; forest and canyon have steel padlocks on their map markers, not giant overlays. Labels sit in intentional open areas on the map, no overlap. Title upper left: 选择远行目的地. Map labels exactly: 苍风原野, 迷雾林地, 赤岩裂谷. Info column: small status 已开放, large heading 苍风原野, two short lines 开阔草原 / 主路通向首领结界, a compact landscape preview. Lower map footnotes beside the locked labels: 击败荒原守门人后解锁 and 击败雾林祭司后解锁. Large warm gold 出发远行 button at the bottom of the right column. Bottom left small functional hint: 选择地图上的目的地. Composition should immediately feel like choosing a place in a coherent world rather than reading a settings dialog. Fine parchment texture within the colorful map, cool blue information column, limited brass detailing. Do not render repeated destination cards.

Direction B: cinematic illustrated destination selection. A refined deep midnight blue modal about 1120x590 on the 1280x720 screen. Header title 选择远行目的地 in warm ivory, subheading 首领胜利后开放下一区域. Three tall illustrated destination panels across the middle, but with asymmetric emphasis: selected first panel roughly 42% of row width, locked second and third each roughly 29%. Each is dominated by a lush hand-painted landscape image, not a text box. The first image: brilliant sunlit green prairie, snaking creek, stone boss gateway far away, lush chunky cartoon vegetation. Second: blue-green misty forest with ancient twisting trees and a rope bridge, visually rich but mildly muted. Third: ochre-red rocky canyon, lava glow and stone ruins, warm and identifiable. First panel subtly raised, substantial clean gold selected outline, small ribbon 已开放. Names 苍风原野 / 迷雾林地 / 赤岩裂谷 are LARGE and very readable on separate dark lower caption surfaces with just one line of copy. First caption: 开阔草原，主路通向首领结界. Locked captions: 击败荒原守门人后解锁 and 击败雾林祭司后解锁, with modest lock symbols. Do not obscure the landscape illustrations with huge dark blankets. A single footer below all three panels contains a selected-state note left 已选择：苍风原野 and large amber 出发远行 button right, with elegant arrow icon. Clearly balanced margins and excellent detail at gameplay scale. Colorful modern cartoon fantasy finish rather than grubby medieval horror. No card-inside-card styling, no diagonal stripes, no green plastic capsule button.

Direction C: warm illustrated adventurer's journal with vertical chapter route. A light ivory parchment main surface and dark teal leather spine, subtle brass bindings and a tasteful brown ink typographic system, distinctly lighter than the blue source screenshot. Use a crisp flat game-interface composition, not a perspective photograph of a book. Top title 远行手册, small subtitle 首领胜利后，继续下一段旅程. Left 30% holds a VERTICAL route navigator of three stations, joined by a single fine dotted path, NO repeated boxed cards. First station a small sun/meadow medallion with an amber selected circle, large label 苍风原野, small status 已开放. Second station a tree medallion with modest padlock, label 迷雾林地, readable line 击败荒原守门人后解锁. Third station a red mountain medallion with modest padlock, label 赤岩裂谷, line 击败雾林祭司后解锁. Spacing makes the route and progression immediately obvious. Right 70% is a single expansive gorgeous hand-painted meadow vista as the selected-destination preview: golden evening sun, green prairie, winding stream, distant stone gateway, chunky fantasy painterly aesthetic. The landscape gently blends into clean cream paper at the bottom, no hard generic card box. In lower right information area, large heading 苍风原野, sentence 开阔草原，主路通向首领结界. A chunky elegant dark moss-green 出发远行 button with warm gold trim at lower right; modest selected-state 已选择 near it. Close X on the outer upper right. Dark graphite-green text on parchment has excellent contrast. Journal wear is slight and controlled; not grunge, not ornate unreadable scrolls. Highly polished readable game UI with much breathing room. No extra mechanics, no currencies.
